item.title: Contratto di ricerca: fiber:loop – Development of an innovative system for the recovery of mineral fibres from construction materials through hydrothermal treatment and microbial biodegradation. (fiber:loop) ERDF 2021-2027, EFRE1136 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

FIBERLoop is an industrial research project focused on the recovery and valorisation of man-made mineral fibres (MMMF), particularly glass wool and rock wool, from construction waste. The project aims to transform them into higher-value secondary materials for use as Supplementary Cementitious Materials (SCM), through mechanical pre-treatment, hydrothermal treatment, biodegradation of phenolic resins, micronisation and characterisation, followed by validation in cementitious products. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Assessing and modeling ecosystem carbon and water fluxes in apple orchards (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The research project focuses on carbon, water, and energy fluxes between the soil–plant system and the atmosphere in apple orchards. Activities will include collecting meteorological and flux data using an eddy covariance station, assessing data quality for processing, generating indicators such as NEP, GPP, NECB, and ET, and developing predictive models in the context of climate change. The contractor will also be expected to perform routine and extraordinary maintenance of the eddy covariance system, ensure remote data transmission, and relocate the system to other sites for short measurement campaigns.
